backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, growth logs, and height prediction data with access control and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report describing a UI-wide neon‑green text color change and listing affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend source files describing their purpose and key behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining theme tokens, including background, foreground, and chart colors for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component wiring authentication, profile loading, theming, and top‑level layout.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with title, description, and generated image promoting growth tracking features.
Layout wrapper providing header, footer, and page structure.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer showing copyright info and link to caffeine.ai with tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with branding and login/logout logic using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/MainContent.tsx: Tabbed interface rendering panels for profile, prediction, growth logs, and tips.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthChart: Recharts-based line chart visualizing height measurements over time.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthLogPa: UI panel for viewing, adding, editing, and deleting height log entries with chart and table display.
frontend/src/features/prediction/compone: Displays a styled loading card with a spinning loader and text while height predictions are calculated.
frontend/src/features/prediction/predict: Implements multiple height prediction formulas and returns their results along with an averaged prediction.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Predict: Landing page offering navigation to standard prediction or puberty-stage estimator.
Controls navigation between landing, standard prediction, and puberty estimator views.
Displays detailed prediction results including average height and per‑formula outputs.
frontend/src/features/prediction/puberty: Estimates bone age from puberty stage and predicts height using bone age, current height, and parental heights.
Defines puberty questionnaire data and computes a puberty stage result based on scored answers.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Puberty: Shows puberty‑stage assessment, estimated bone age, and height prediction based on questionnaire results.
Guided multi‑step puberty questionnaire that calculates and displays developmental stage results.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Standar: Runs standard height prediction formulas using profile data and displays calculated results.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileInp: Profile form component allowing users to input personal and height data, syncs with saved profile, and handles submission.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileSet: Initial profile setup dialog collecting basic user info and saving a default profile.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/re: Provides age-based diet and exercise recommendation lists and a function to return them.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/Re: Shows personalized diet and exercise recommendations with disclaimers, based on the user's profile.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refetching dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines data-fetching and mutation hooks for user profiles, growth logs, and predictions via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeActor.ts: Like useActor but safely initializes access control, ensuring a usable actor even if setup fails.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based theme variables and dark mode styles using green-focused color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/age.ts: Utility functions for calculating age from birthdates or year values.
frontend/src/utils/heightInput.ts: Utilities for sanitizing, formatting, and parsing height inputs with unit-specific rules.
frontend/src/utils/units.ts: Provides conversions between cm, inches, and feet-inches formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed. Supports both regular and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, container settings, and includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s state metadata, existing features, new feature requests, and configuration for project tracking.
